exposure: mother's choice in mode of delivery
outcome: mother's preference for mode of delivery (for successive pregnancy)
perception regarding commercial interest in CS
cohort: The study included all deliveries that occurred over the last three years in the urban area of Surat, Gujarat.
finding: The study revealed very high Caesarean section rates, predominantly in the private sector, suggesting potential commercial interests.
mod_finding: The majority of mothers (98.4%) were not given a choice regarding their mode of delivery, and most (97.3%) preferred vaginal delivery over CS for successive pregnancies.
cross-section timing: Data was collected on deliveries that occurred over the last 3 years.
